title: Introducing PaddleFlux — Smart Queueing for Pickleball Open Play
content:
## The Problem

We've all been there. You show up to open play, someone grabs a clipboard, and the next 45 minutes are a mess of **"who's played the most?"**, **"did Sarah already play twice?"**, and **"wait, when did Mike last get on court?"**

Manual queueing is slow, unfair, and kills the vibe. That's why we built **PaddleFlux**.

## What is PaddleFlux?

PaddleFlux is a free, web-based queueing and matchmaking system designed specifically for pickleball open play sessions. It handles the hard part — **fair court rotation, skill-balanced teams, and real-time tracking** — so you can focus on playing.

Create a session, check in players, and let the algorithm do the rest.

## How It Works

### 1. Create a Session
Set the number of courts, choose a matching mode, and give your session a name. It takes less than 30 seconds.

### 2. Check In Players
Add players one by one or import a list. Assign star ratings (1-5) to reflect skill levels. The algorithm uses these to create balanced matches.

### 3. Start Matches
Tap **GO** on any court. PaddleFlux instantly picks the next 4 players based on skill balance, wait time, and how many games each person has played.

### 4. Record Results
When a match ends, enter the score. The system updates rankings, tracks streaks, and picks the next group — all automatically.

## Key Features

### Skill-Balanced Matchmaking
Teams are paired so every game is competitive. No more stacked teams where one side dominates.

### Fair Court Time
The algorithm guarantees **equal rotation**. Everyone plays the same number of games, whether you're a 2-star or a 5-star player.

### No Repeat Opponents
In **Casual mode**, you'll never face the same opponent twice until everyone has played. This keeps games fresh and fun.

### Live Spectator View
Share a live link so friends, family, or other players can follow the action in real time — courts, queue, leaderboards, and all.

### Real-Time Leaderboards
Rankings update after every match. Track wins, losses, win rate, and streaks. End-of-session awards recognize MVPs, most improved players, and more.

### Fixed Pairs
Playing with a partner? Lock two players as a **fixed pair** and they'll always be matched together, with fair rotation guaranteed.

### Comeback Bracket Mode
For competitive sessions, the **Comeback mode** splits the queue into Winners and Losers brackets. Players move between brackets based on their results — giving everyone a chance to fight back.

### Club Raid Mode
Organizing a inter-club tournament? **Club Raid** divides players into clubs, runs a round-robin schedule, and tracks club standings and fair play order.

## Who Is It For?

- **Open play organizers** who want fair, automated rotation
- **Pickleball clubs** running regular sessions
- **Tournament directors** managing brackets and seeding
- **Any group** that plays pickleball and wants better matchmaking

## Getting Started

No sign-up required. Head to the homepage, tap **Create Open Play**, and you're live in under a minute.

Share the QR code or live link with your players and they can track their queue position, upcoming matches, and stats from their phone.
